steps.player: Wow, didn't expect to find a scientist out here.

steps.npc: I'm out here on a mission, do you think I chose to hang around these lowlifes?

steps.player: I'm not one to judge.
What is this 'mission' you mentioned?

steps.npc: I'm out here to conduct research, I've been told a giant spider lurks in the heart of the Wilderness.
Her venom is priceless and it would aid me greatly in my research.

steps.player: Research? What could you possibly want with a giant spider's venom?

steps.npc: Venenatis is the last of her kind. Lots of giant spiders used to dwell deep in the mountains until the savage dwarves killed them all.
She is the last one left and I must have a sample of her venom.
What I want with the specimen however, is none of your business!

steps.player: Woah sorry, didn't mean to touch a nerve. Fighting a giant spider sounds like a great idea.

steps.npc: I've tried to put it off for as long as I could, but this is the final component needed for my research.

steps.player: Then what are you waiting around here for? Go out there and fight her.

steps.text: With at least one Venenatis kill:

steps.player: Are you sure you're equipped to take it down? I've had the displeasure of dealing with Venenatis, she will not go down easily.

steps.npc: It will not be easy, but if I can get her when she's wounded in her lair, it should be a fairer fight.

steps.player: I didn't know she had a lair. I thought she just roamed the Wilderness.

steps.npc: She only returns there to lick her wounds and rest, I need to be patient.

steps.player: So that explains why you're waiting here.

steps.npc: I would go out and fight her now, but I must admit, I am also a little scared. I've never been in a fight before.

steps.player: I'm sure you'll be alright, it's just a gigantic spider!

steps.npc: Thanks for your words of confidence...

options.condition: If the player has Thammaron's sceptre or the Skull of Vet'ion:

steps.text: With only Thammaron's sceptre in the inventory:

steps.player: Hey. Do you know anything about this?

steps.text: You show the sceptre to Phabelle Bile.

steps.npc: Well, would you look at that. Most fascinating.

steps.player: Could you tell me what's so fascinating?

steps.npc: It's a rare Zamorakian artifact. I haven't seen any quite like this one before.
If you look closely, you can see that it has a socket where you can place an item to increase its power.

steps.player: Interesting! I'll be on the lookout for that.

steps.text: With only the Skull of Vet'ion in the inventory:

steps.player: Hey. Do you know anything about this?

steps.text: You show the skull to Phabelle Bile.

steps.npc: So it's real. Magnificent.

steps.player: You've seen this before?

steps.npc: No, but I have heard tales of the mighty Vet'Ion.
It is said his skull can power a certain Zamorakian weapon.

steps.player: Interesting! I'll be on the lookout for that.
Hey. Do you know anything about this?

steps.text: You show the sceptre to Phabelle Bile.

steps.npc: Well, would you look at that. Most fascinating.

steps.player: Could you tell me what's so fascinating?

steps.npc: It's a rare Zamorakian artifact. I haven't seen any quite like this one before.
If you look closely, you can see that it has a socket where you can place an item to increase its power.

steps.player: Oh, like this skull?

steps.text: You show the skull to Phabelle Bile.

steps.npc: Yes, like that one! That looks powerful indeed. I think that would do quite nicely.
A skilled crafter can combine the two. If you wish, I could do it for you... For a price, that is.

steps.prompt: Pay 500,000 coins to combine the skull and sceptre?

steps.text: If the player does not have enough coins:

steps.player: I don't have the money for that.

steps.npc: Feel free to come back when you do.

steps.text: If the player has enough coins:
Phabelle Bile combines the items and gives you the Accursed sceptre (au).

steps.npc: There we go! All done.

steps.player: No thanks.

using-items-on-her-claws-of-callisto.player: Hey. Do you know anything about this?

using-items-on-her-claws-of-callisto.text: You show the claws to Phabelle Bile.

using-items-on-her-claws-of-callisto.player: Oh. Do you know someone who might know more?

using-items-on-her-claws-of-callisto.npc: Andros Mai is a very... Devoted man. If you can see past that, he may be able to help you.

using-items-on-her-fangs-of-venenatis.player: Hey. Do you know anything about this?

using-items-on-her-fangs-of-venenatis.text: You show the fangs to Phabelle Bile.

using-items-on-her-fangs-of-venenatis.npc: Ah, but they contain no more venom. That is disappointing.
To me? Yes. But maybe not to you.
I've seen that Derse Venator guy over there handle similar items. Perhaps he knows more.

using-items-on-her-voidwaker-part.player: Hey. Do you know anything about this?

using-items-on-her-voidwaker-part.text: You show the weapon piece to Phabelle Bile.

using-items-on-her-voidwaker-part.player: Oh. Do you know someone who might know more?

using-items-on-her-voidwaker-part.npc: Downstairs there's a strange looking person. I don't know what that item is, but if anyone would, I reckon she would.
I think she said her name was Madam Sikaro.
